The test image shows a sugarcane leaf with distinct pale/white longitudinal streaks running parallel to the leaf veins. There are also small orange-red spots. The streaking pattern parallel to veins is characteristic of Leaf Scald (Xanthomonas albilineans).

Let me view one reference image to confirm.

The reference Leaf_Scald image shows advanced yellowing/scalding. The test image has narrower white streaks on a still-green leaf, which is more consistent with early-stage Leaf Scald (characteristic white pencil-line streaks parallel to veins caused by Xanthomonas albilineans). The small orange-red spots are likely secondary.
